name: Festival Stone of Solclaim
title: Festival Stone of Solclaim
summary: One of the Festival Stones, 'in the parched wastelands to the east of Al-Arqas' (Alatar Locke). In the kit the stone and its glow stand on a low dune (z 24) at the centre of a 20 m square of four 3 m candle sentinels with blue lights; bare yellow sand all round, no trees.

landmarks.name: Festival Stone of Solclaim
landmarks.note: Festival Stone spawn with the Anniversary glow.

landmarks.name: Four candle sentinels (0x0200039B)
landmarks.note: At the corners (28562/28582, 17066/17086) with blue lights.

site.name: Festival Stone of Solclaim
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer solclaim-festival-stone (dune 13 m north-west of the stone, inside the sentinel square).

shots.standingOrder: Circle a quarter turn 24 m out and 10 m above the glowing Solclaim stone and its square of four candle sentinels on the bare yellow dunes; keep 10 m from every sentinel, desert rats may be faded.
shots.notes: Quarter orbit of the Solclaim Festival Stone in its square of four 3 m candle sentinels with blue lights, alone on bare yellow dunes (Alatar Locke: 'the parched wastelands east of Al-Arqas'); the afternoon WSW sun rakes the dunes and the sentinels' shadows.
